628:t_1:90.en: ～ $$ラース・バビロン$$ Imperial Palace - Front Courtyard ～

628:t_1:91.en:
$$沙慈$$
「$$刹那$$! And $$バナージ$$ too!」

628:t_1:93.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Just so you know, $$ミコット$$ and I are here too!」

628:t_1:94.en:
$$ルイス$$
「I'm sorry. But I never imagined we'd meet in a place like this.」

628:t_1:95.en:
$$刹那$$
「It's the same for me, $$ルイス・ハレヴィ$$.」

628:t_1:96.en:
$$ルイス$$
「I'm glad, $$刹那$$. There was so much I wanted to talk to you about.」

628:t_1:98.en:
$$ルイス$$
「Hee hee... We didn't get along when we first met, and we even fought each other in mobile suits, didn't we?」

628:t_1:99.en:
$$刹那$$
「But now we can be happy to see each other again like this. People can change.」

628:t_1:100.en:
$$ルイス$$
「You're right. When I see your smile, I can really feel it.」

628:t_1:102.en:
$$ミコット$$
「We're carrying messages from $$カレン$$ and $$スザク$$, too. They said once things settle down, they'd like to meet you and take their time talking.」

628:t_1:103.en:
$$ルイス$$
「Tell them I'd be glad to... I want to see the two of them, too.」

628:t_1:104.en:
$$沙慈$$
「So it was $c that set us free, wasn't it?」

628:t_1:105.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Still, I'm glad. Glad you're both safe like this.」

628:t_1:106.en:
$$ルイス$$
「Because $$沙慈$$... kept protecting me the whole time.」

628:t_1:108.en:
$$沙慈$$
「Tell us, $$刹那$$. Everything that's happened to you from when we parted ways until today.」

628:t_1:109.en:
$$刹那$$
「A lot has happened... But I'm alive, too.」

628:t_1:110.en:
$$沙慈$$
「Looks like you've gotten stronger again, $$刹那$$.」

628:t_1:114.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$リボンズ・アルマーク$$!」

628:t_1:120.en:
$$刹那$$
「This sensation...! Are those the $$脳量子波$$ that one is emitting!」

628:t_1:121.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is that what's been tormenting $$ルイス$$!」

628:t_1:123.en:
$$刹那$$
「Are you the same type of $$イノベイド$$ as $$リボンズ・アルマーク$$?」

628:t_1:125.en:
$$刹那$$
「Answer! If you don't, I'll shoot!」

628:t_1:129.en:
$$ミコット$$
「No way...! It's not working!」

628:t_1:132.en:
$$刹那$$
「If it doesn't even bleed, it's no $$イノベイド$$ either...! Then!」

628:t_1:134.en:
$$刹那$$
「Either I run out of bullets first, or this thing runs out of strength first!」

628:t_1:137.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The $$脳量子波$$... have stopped...」

628:t_1:140.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「What on earth is this thing...」

628:t_1:143.en:
$$バナージ$$
「A metal that emits $$脳量子波$$... Could it be that this is...」

628:t_1:145.en:
$n
「$$刹那$$, $$バナージ$$! Get everyone here back into the Imperial Palace right now!」

628:t_1:147.en:
$n
「It's the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...! They're mimicking humans and attacking people who have $$脳量子波$$ or psychic waves!」

628:t_1:148.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「To think those things have come down to Earth...!」

628:t_1:149.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is the full-scale invasion by the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ about to begin...」

628:t_1:154.en: ～ $$地球連邦軍$$ Research Facility $$ブレインズ$$ ～

628:t_1:156.en:
$$ロイド$$
「So this little cutie is the high school girl Dr. $$トライア$$ sent over, huh?」

628:t_1:157.en:
$$セシル$$
「Her name is $$アーミア・リー$$. Until a few days ago, she was being held at $$ラース・バビロン$$ to be used in the $$霊子吸収システム$$, but...」

628:t_1:158.en:
$$セシル$$
「After she was freed from it, half of her body was eroded by an $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ mimicking a human.」

628:t_1:159.en:
$$ビリー$$
「From the report by $c, we knew the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ are drawn to $$脳量子波$$, but I never imagined they would erode the human body itself...」

628:t_1:160.en:
$$ラクシャータ$$
「Since they're drawn to $$脳量子波$$, it stands to reason that, at bottom, the human body itself is what they're out to erode.」

628:t_1:162.en:
$$セシル$$
「People who emit psychic waves, like $$イノベイター$$s and $$ニュータイプ$$s... in other words, humanity of the new era.」

628:t_1:163.en:
$$ミーナ#pt169$$
「Could this have something to do with the $$サイデリアル$$ monitoring the evolution of humanity...?」

628:t_1:164.en:
$$ロイド$$
「Who knows... But the situation has gotten troublesome.」

628:t_1:165.en:
$$セシル$$
「Our investigation found that the $$霊子吸収システム$$ held not only Earthnoids but Spacenoids as well.」

628:t_1:166.en:
$$セシル$$
「In other words, until now, most of the people in the $$地球圏$$ who emit $$脳量子波$$ have been protected by that facility.」

628:t_1:167.en:
$$ラクシャータ$$
「Whether it was coincidence or not, I can't say, but it seems that, as a result, this delayed the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ invasion of Earth.」

628:t_1:169.en:
$$ビリー$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ are thought to transmit information by $$脳量子波$$...」

628:t_1:170.en:
$$ビリー$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ horde at the edge of the $$地球圏$$ has probably learned from the vanguard on Earth that many people emitting $$脳量子波$$ exist.」

628:t_1:171.en:
$$ミーナ#pt169$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ will soon come to Earth...」
